definitionEn: to examine something in detail in order to understand it
exampleSentence: Researchers analyze the data before drawing conclusions.

definitionHe: אף על פי כן, ובכל זאת
definitionEn: in spite of what has just been said
exampleSentence: The evidence was thin; nevertheless, the theory persisted.

definitionEn: suggested or understood without being directly stated
exampleSentence: The contract carried an implicit assumption that both parties would act in good faith.

definitionEn: coming after something in time; following
exampleSentence: The initial trial produced weak results, but subsequent studies confirmed the effect.

definitionEn: open to more than one interpretation; not clearly defined
exampleSentence: The instructions were ambiguous, so several teams interpreted the task differently.

definitionEn: to make an action or process easier
exampleSentence: A shared glossary of key terms can facilitate communication between researchers from different fields.

definitionEn: to severely restrict the scope or freedom of an action
exampleSentence: Limited funding constrained the scope of the study.

definitionHe: שרירותי, המבוסס על החלטה אישית ולא על כלל קבוע
definitionEn: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system
exampleSentence: The committee's decision seemed arbitrary, with no documented criteria behind it.

definitionHe: לכיד ועקבי; הגיוני ומובנה מבחינה פנימית
definitionEn: logical and consistent; forming a unified whole
exampleSentence: The author presents a coherent argument that builds logically from one paragraph to the next.

definitionHe: בעוד ש, לעומת זאת (ניגוד בין שתי עובדות)
definitionEn: in contrast to the fact that; while on the other hand
exampleSentence: The northern region relies on agriculture, whereas the southern region depends on tourism.
The bridge was closed for repairs; consequently, traffic was rerouted through the old town.

definitionEn: in spite of; without being opposed by
exampleSentence: Notwithstanding several objections, the committee approved the new policy.
